upstream.note: annotated tag; the pinned SHA is the peeled commit

runtime.servletStack: Spring Boot embedded Tomcat (jakarta.servlet) + Jersey (spring-boot-starter-jersey) application under /fineract-provider/api/v1/*; Spring Security Basic auth
runtime.jersey: 3.1.11 (jersey-server/jersey-common 3.1.11 in BOOT-INF/lib, Jakarta REST; verified from the built jar)
runtime.database: PostgreSQL 18.3 (tenant store fineract_tenants + tenant db fineract_default)

resetProcedure: Every run removes and recreates the private network, Postgres container (data on tmpfs, role root) and app container, then creates database fineract_default; on first start Fineract's Liquibase initializes the tenant store, tenant schema and seeds (office 1, mifos user).
configAdaptations: FINERACT_SERVER_SSL_ENABLED=false and FINERACT_SERVER_PORT=8080 (loopback HTTP instead of the upstream default HTTPS 8443)
FINERACT_HIKARI_*/FINERACT_DEFAULT_TENANTDB_* env point at the campaign Postgres container (upstream's documented env contract)
build runs bootJar only: tests and spotless are skipped; no source changes
Postgres data directory on tmpfs and fsync=off (disposable data)
JVM -Xmx2g, container memory 3g, TZ=UTC (tenant timezone left at upstream default Asia/Kolkata)

auth.scheme: HTTP Basic (upstream demo mifos/password) + Fineract-Platform-TenantId: default
auth.note: credentials are Fineract's documented synthetic seed; Authorization header redacted in receipts

seams: 12 parallel ClientsApiResource.create+retrieveOne, 16 parallel OfficesApiResource.retrieveOffice; recordings must not cross-associate
domain-rule rejection deleting an active client

notApplicable.outbound: no outbound dependency exercised: Fineract's hooks/notification senders are not configured in this campaign (no deterministic local dependency added to avoid unrequested scope)
